+        if verbose:print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
+    def servo(point,grip=1,gain=kp,damp=kd,limit=speed):
+        nonlocal prev_tcp
+        tcp=s.env.tcp_center.copy();velocity=(tcp-prev_tcp)/.0125;prev_tcp=tcp
+        a=np.clip(gain*(np.array(point)-tcp)-damp*velocity,-limit,limit)
+        s.step(np.r_[a,grip])

+            obj=s.obs[4:6].copy();remaining=np.dot(goal-obj,direction)
+            if remaining<.002:break
+            next_obj=obj+direction*min(remaining,through)
+            corr=goal-next_obj-np.dot(goal-next_obj,direction)*direction
